title: Arctic little guy, moving better
body:
Redid the Arctic little guy's animations with the updated rig and 200-step Kimodo takes. The arms bend more naturally now, and the mittens follow the forearms without the stiff wrist rotation.

A few picks from the set: wave, walk, run and celebrate. Rendered at 60 fps in Asset Showcase Studio, with a steady camera and the generated travel and height motion preserved.

videos.caption: Arctic Wanderer: wave, walk, run and celebrate. Silent, 1080p60.
